title: Oil Industry
name: 3-3/2 Way Solenoid Valve
description:
A Solenoid Valve is an electrically controlled valve. The valve features a solenoid, which is an electric coil with a movable ferromagnetic core (plunger) in its center. In the rest position, the plunger closes off a small orifice.
When an electric current is passed through the coil, it creates a magnetic field that pulls the plunger away from the orifice, allowing fluid to flow through the valve. When the current is turned off, the plunger returns to its original position, closing the valve and stopping the flow of fluid.
material: Brass

title: Gas Product Categories
name: Poppet Valves
description:
A poppet valve (also called mushroom valve) is a valve typically used to control the timing and quantity of gas or vapor flow into an engine.
It consists of a hole or open-ended chamber, usually round or oval in cross-section, and a plug, usually a disk shape on the end of a shaft known as a valve stem. The working end of this plug, the valve face, is typically ground at a 45° bevel to seal against a corresponding valve seat ground into the rim of the chamber being sealed. The shaft travels through a valve guide to maintain its alignment.
material: Aluminium, Nitrile, Brass, Polymer

Gate Valves are used to isolate specific areas of the water supply network during maintenance, repair works, new installations, as well as to reroute water flow throughout the pipeline.

title: Nuclear Industry Product
name: Boltted Bonnet Globe Valves
description:
A Globe Valve, different from ball valve, is a type of valve used for regulating flow in a pipeline, consisting of a movable plug or disc element and a stationary ring seat in a generally spherical body.
Globe Valves are named for their spherical body shape with the two halves of the body being separated by an internal baffle. This has an opening that forms a seat onto which a movable plug can be screwed in to close (or shut) the valve. The plug is also called a disc.

title: Nuclear Industry Product
name: Full Opening Check Valve
description:
Check valves are generally installed in pipelines to prevent backflow. A check valve is basically a one-way valve, in which the flow can run freely one way, but if the flow turns the valve will close to protect the piping, other valves, pumps etc.
If the flow turns and no check valve is installed, water hammer can occur. Water hammer often occur with an extreme force and will easily damage a pipeline or components.

title: Nuclear Industry Product
name: Pilot Operated Safety Valve
description:
A Pressure Relief Valve is a safety device designed to protect a pressurized vessel or system during an overpressure event..
An Overpressure event refers to any condition which would cause pressure in a vessel or system to increase beyond the specified design pressure or maximum allowable working pressure (MAWP).
The primary purpose of a pressure Relief Valve is protection of life and property by venting fluid from an over pressurized vessel.

title: Nuclear Industry Product
name: Lubricated Plug Valve
description:
Plug Valves are valves with cylindrical or conically tapered plugs which can be rotated inside the valve body to control flow through the valve.
The Plugs in Plug Valves have one or more hollow passageways going sideways through the plug, so that fluid can flow through the plug when the valve is open. Plug valves are simple and often economical.

title: Nuclear Industry Product
name: Eccentric Plug Valve
description: Eccentric Plug Valves are a type of plug valve in which the plug is offset from the centerline of the valve body. This offset allows for better sealing and reduced wear compared to standard plug valves.

title: Nuclear Industry Product
name: Straight Diaphragm Valves
description: Diaphragm valves are used in applications where contamination of the fluid being controlled must be avoided. The diaphragm acts as a barrier between the fluid and the valve's moving parts.

title: Nuclear Industry Product
name: Single Seated Control Valve
description: Single seated control valves are used in applications where precise control of fluid flow is required. They feature a single seat and a single valve plug.

title: Nuclear Industry Product
name: Lubricated Ball Valve
description: A Ball Valve is a shut off valve that controls the flow of a liquid or gas by means of a rotary ball having a bore. By rotating the ball a quarter turn (90 degrees) around its axis, the medium can flow through or is blocked. ,br /> They are characterized by a long service life and provide a reliable sealing over the life span, even when the valve is not in use for a long time.

title: Nuclear Industry Product
name: Reduced Bore Ball Valve
description: A Reduced Bore Ball Valve is a type of ball valve where the bore diameter is smaller than the nominal pipe size. This design allows for a more compact valve while maintaining the same flow characteristics.

title: Nuclear Industry Product
name: Rising Stem Ball Valve
description: A Rising Stem Ball Valve is a type of ball valve where the stem rises as the valve is opened. This design allows for visual confirmation of the valve position and is commonly used in applications requiring precise control.

title: Nuclear Industry Product
name: V-Port Ball Valve
description: A V-Port Ball Valve is a type of ball valve with a V-shaped port in the ball. This design allows for precise flow control and is commonly used in applications requiring linear flow characteristics.

title: Nuclear Industry Product
name: Water Lug Type Butterfly Valve
description: A Butterfly Valve is a quarter-turn rotary motion valve that uses a disc to control the flow of fluid. It is commonly used in applications where quick shut-off and precise flow control are required.

title: Nuclear Industry Product
name: Tipple Offset Butterfly Valve
description: A Tipple Offset Butterfly Valve is a type of butterfly valve with an offset disc that provides better sealing and flow characteristics compared to standard butterfly valves.

title: Nuclear Industry Product
name: Flange Type Butterfly Valve
description: A Flange Type Butterfly Valve is a butterfly valve that is connected to pipes using flanges. This design allows for easy installation and maintenance.
